groupPolicyEditor.title: Group policies
groupPolicyEditor.description: One policy per group, applied to every current member and to containers that join later.
groupPolicyEditor.ownership: Stored in Drydock, not in Docker labels. Labels and per-container overrides on members still win for update-policy fields.
groupPolicyEditor.empty: No groups or policies yet. Groups come from dd.group, Compose projects and Swarm stacks.
groupPolicyEditor.noMembers: No current members; applies to future members
groupPolicyEditor.whitespaceNotice: The name has leading or trailing whitespace, shown as ␣.
groupPolicyEditor.readOnly: Only admins can change group policies. This view is read-only.

editor.groupNameHelp: Matched exactly. Case and spaces count.
editor.groupNameInvalid: Enter a group name that is not blank.
editor.minAgeHelp: Whole days, 1 to 365. Leave empty to inherit.
editor.minAgeInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365.
editor.listHelp: One per line or comma separated.
editor.updateModeHelp: Group rules can only restrict. Current global mode: {mode}.
editor.excludeHelp: Trigger id or name, optionally followed by :threshold. One per line or comma separated.
editor.noFields: Set at least one field, or remove the policy.
editor.conflict: This policy was changed by someone else. Reload it, then apply your change again. Your draft stays until you reload.
editor.notFound: This policy no longer exists. Reload to see the current list.
editor.forbidden: Admin access is required to change group policies.

remove.message: Remove the policy for group {group}? Members fall back to their label, watcher and global values.

groupPolicyEditor.saved: Policy saved. {members} container updated. | Policy saved. {members} containers updated.
groupPolicyEditor.removed: Policy removed. {members} container updated. | Policy removed. {members} containers updated.

errors.unknown: Could not save the group policy
